objective: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.
Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

description: The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.
Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.
progress: Hello, <race>. What can I do for you?
completion: Oh... I have never seen anything like this...

note: The direct quest has no item reward. Its follow-up, In Nightmares, later offers:
pickup: Item start: Glowing Shard, dropped by Mutanus the Devourer
turnin: Follow the quest directions beginning in Ratchet
